title: Authentication Requirement
text: Successful exploitation of the vulnerability requires authenticated access. Unauthenticated users cannot execute the attack.

title: Version Range
text: The vulnerability affects software versions 2.0 through 2.5. Version 2.6 contains the security patch.

title: Feature Condition
text: Remote exploitation is possible only when Feature A is enabled.

title: Administrative Privilege
text: Successful exploitation requires administrator privileges on the target system.

title: Mitigation Exception
text: The mitigation protects affected systems except when legacy configuration mode is enabled.
